text.tspan: SQSO-HW-DIAG-001 · dashed = part not selected · values from the board build-to designs
Netlist of record: hardware/electrical/rf/design.py (SKiDL) -> rf_board.net, BOM, ERC log; calculations: rf_calcs.py; BASELINE 7
also to the squarer U301 -> LMX2571 OSCin, PCM1808 SCKI (PA domain)
Readbacks to OBC inputs through 1 k: TONE_OK (J1-8), XPDR_KEY (J1-9), PTT_EXCITER (J1-10); STM32 pins allocated by the OBC designer (RID RF-21)
TX_PERMIT_HW = PA_5V present (U804 Schmitt); a second, independent divider enables U805, the switch that powers the LMX2571
PA domain (unpowered unless SW3/RF_TX_EN): PCM1808, squarer, detectors, APC, PA. LMX2571 on a switch enabled by PA_5V presence. TX_TEMP: TMP235 on the PA pad (always powered).
TX-OFF removes the PA supply and, through TX_PERMIT_HW, the exciter's power and CE: two hardware paths.
